## About FPVS Toolbox

FPVS Toolbox was designed specifically for non-expert users and is intended to streamline FPVS data processing. No coding experience is required, and this package can process large FPVS datasets in just a few clicks. FPVS Toolbox is designed to work directly with the FPVS Studio, so users can easily import their FPVS Studio projects and set up their data analysis with ease. The toolbox outputs data in both wide and long format, making statistical analysis with software like R or SPSS straightforward. 

The processing methodology used in FPVS Toolbox is based on recently published methods (see the Suggested Reading section) and is currently compatible with BioSemi data formats. Future updates will include support for additional data formats. 

## Requirements

- OS - Windows 10 or later
- RAM: 16GB recommended 
- CPU: Intel i5 or equivalent recommended
- Storage: At least 5GB of free space for installation of FPVS Toolbox and required libraries.
